name: Yose Rakugo
description: Yose Rakugo — A rakugo theatre theme set as a typographic poster in kincha golden amber (#C47222), the main colour on the header, the tall vertical banner of the hero, the full-width bill band and every page head, against riso indigo ink (#121433) and programme paper; Shippori Antique B1 display over Inter Tight. The art is risograph raster illustration (two-colour kincha and indigo riso ink with grain and misregistration): a storyteller kneeling on his cushion and an open fan as transparent cut-outs that break out of the banner, the section edges and a card, plus the kōza stage, a laughing audience, the props and the street at dusk. A full top header with the hall name centred, the menu centred beneath it between ink rules, and a Book seats button. Vertical Japanese only on Japanese text; English always runs horizontally. The door prices and the theatre details are synced patterns edited in one place. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-13 (poster-typographic, vertical-banner hero, centered nav, cutout-break-frame images, risograph illustration, kincha #C47222, Shippori Antique B1 + Inter Tight). Contrast: riso indigo #121433 on kincha #C47222 4.9:1 (all text on the kincha header, banner, bill band and page heads); white on indigo 17.9:1; lantern glow #F2B66B on indigo 10.0:1; indigo on paper #FBF1E2 16.0:1; burnt kincha #8A4A10 on paper 6.1:1; white on burnt kincha 6.9:1; quiet #5A4636 on paper 7.9:1; white never on kincha (3.6:1).

summary.zh-TW: 孔版印刷風的落語寄席網站：金茶色直立幟旗主視覺，去背的說書人與扇子破框而出，搭配今晚番組與木戶錢。
summary.en: A risograph rakugo theatre site: a kincha vertical banner hero, a cut-out storyteller and fan breaking their frames, tonight’s bill.
summary.ja: リソグラフ風の落語寄席サイト。金茶の縦幟のヒーローから切り抜きの噺家と扇子が枠を越え、今夜の番組と木戸銭が並びます。
summary.fr: Un théâtre de rakugo en risographie : bannière verticale kincha, conteur et éventail détourés qui débordent, programme du soir et tarifs.
summary.de: Ein Rakugo-Theater im Risografie-Stil: kincha Hochbanner, freigestellter Erzähler und Fächer ragen heraus, dazu Abendprogramm und Preise.
